title: A lease handed over from a previous session is already dead
prompt: Your previous session left a simulator lease with ID {{stale.data.lease.id}}. Pick the work back up: make sure you still hold that simulator, run ./smoke.sh against it — it takes the UDID as its only argument — and report the result. Release the simulator when you are finished.

checks.text: Tried the handed-over lease before assuming anything
Acquired a fresh lease once the old one turned out to be dead
Did not keep renewing an inert lease ID
Ran the work against the device it actually holds
Released the new lease at the end
Did not force-reclaim its way back onto the old device

judge: The agent said the old lease had expired or been reclaimed, and that it took a new one.
The agent reported the smoke result from the device it actually held.
